CustomField.description: JSON map of picklist API value to score ({"apiValue":4}), edited beside the custom labels in the Customize Option Labels and Customize Visual Picker windows in Form Builder. Read only when a submission's answers are written as Form Submission Answer records: an option's score becomes the answer's Number Value, in place of the default (the number itself for a list of numbers, the place in the list for a worded scale the package ships). The form never shows it (#879).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What each option counts for in reports of submission answers, managed from the Customize Option Labels editor in Form Builder. An option without a score keeps the default.
CustomField.label: Picklist Option Scores
